question: Quantos pedidos foram cancelados?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: Quantos clientes temos em cada estado?
expected_sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY state

question: Qual a receita total por categoria, sem contar pedidos cancelados?
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.name

question: Quais são os 5 produtos com maior receita, considerando todos os pedidos?
expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Quantos pedidos existem em cada status?
expected_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: Qual foi a receita total de 2024, desconsiderando pedidos cancelados?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.ordered_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2025-01-01'

question: Quantos pedidos foram feitos por mês em 2025?
expected_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', ordered_at), COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1

question: Quantos clientes nunca fizeram nenhum pedido?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)
